name: Lacerta
introduction: is the Lizard, a small zigzag of stars between Cygnus and Andromeda. Johannes Hevelius introduced it in 1687. Lying in the Milky Way, it is best seen on northern autumn evenings.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Lacerta gave its name to a whole class of galaxies. BL Lacertae was cataloged as a variable star, but it turned out to be the bright core of a distant galaxy whose jet points almost directly at Earth. Such objects are now called BL Lac objects, a kind of blazar.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Stellio](hip:111169), Alpha Lacertae, is a white star about 100 light-years away. [5 Lacertae](hip:111022) is a red supergiant with a hot blue companion, and [Beta Lacertae](hip:110538) a yellow giant.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: In 1936, the nova CP Lacertae became one of the brightest novae of the 20th century. Several open clusters lie along the Milky Way in Lacerta.
